messages:
emma: heads-up — planning a staged switchover to enable orca-13b-rev2 as the default generator for text-gen workloads in the catalog. target change window: Tue 02:00 UTC.
ashwin: 👍 what's the fallback ladder look like? we should avoid hitting larger models if latency spikes.
emma: plan is: primary orca-13b-rev2 -> fallback orca-13b-quant -> fallback titan-lite -> legacy-gpt-small. keeping the cost-latency tradeoffs explicit.
jordan: can we add a short-circuit to prefer quant variant only when tokens/sec < threshold? otherwise prefer primary.
ashwin: yes — we'll route by sequence length + latency SLO. I can add a routing rule: if p95(latency, 1m) > 350ms then prefer titan-lite.
sre-oncall: during the window I'll watch p50/p95 and errors. who owns rollback if we see generation quality regressions?
emma: product/quality will own verification. if eval suite fail rate > 3% or subjective regressions called out by QA in first 30m -> rollback trigger.
kevin: put the automatic rollback threshold in the release note and the deploybot guard so we don't need manual approval for emergency revert.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: enable_model_variant("orca-13b-rev2", rollout=10%, ttl=30m) at 1971240000 by emma. Canary checks: health, p95 latency, eval-fail-rate, error-rate.
as hwin: tiny nit — can we do 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% over 45m with checks at each step? reduces blast radius.
emma: yes let's do staged increments with manual hold between stages. ops will be oncall for the window to approve stage increases.
ashwin: config snippet I will push to the catalog (example):
```
- variant: orca-13b-rev2
  rollout: [10,30,60,100]
  checks:
    - metric: p95_latency
      max: 350
    - metric: eval_fail_rate
      max: 0.03
  fallback_order: [orca-13b-quant, titan-lite, legacy-gpt-small]
```
jordan: please make sure TTL for canary pins is 15m per stage so we can quick-evict.
emma: agreed. also adding observability tasks: add a dashboard tab for sample outputs and token-level cost delta so product can eyeball quality vs cost.
kevin: tagging legal/compliance not required for this change right?
emma: not required — model and data access are unchanged. we do need to note model version in the audit log.
sre-oncall: I'll prep a runbook section: quick commands to force-pin old variant + drain new connections. example:
```
curl -X POST $CATA_API/pin -d '{"model":"orca-13b","variant":"legacy-gpt-small","reason":"rollback"}'
```
ashwin: after rollout completes, plan a 24h observation window and a follow-up post-mortem doc with perf/quality deltas.
emma: all set. @deploy-bot please proceed with scheduled staged rollout. I'll coordinate QA on standby.
deploy-bot: acknowledged. will start at scheduled time and post stage updates here. :rocket:
